Seyi Makinde, alongside his running mate, Alhaji Lawal Musa Daura, and other party candidates, on Saturday paid a courtesy visit to the Emir of Bauchi, His Royal Highness, Alhaji (Dr.) Rilwanu Sulaiman Adamu. The delegation visited the Emir at his palace in Bauchi metropolis, where they paid homage to the traditional ruler. The delegation was led to the palace by Bauchi State Governor and APM leader, Senator Bala Abdulkadir Mohammed. Makinde was in Bauchi on Saturday for the official flag-off of his presidential campaign ahead of the 2027 general elections.
